```{r global-options_taxa, include=FALSE}
.bcw <- function(i, default = "100%") {
  w <- imgInfo$barchart_width
  if (!is.null(w) && length(w) >= i && !is.na(w[i])) w[i] else default
}
fig_out_width_p  <- .bcw(1)
fig_out_width_c  <- .bcw(2)
fig_out_width_o  <- .bcw(3)
fig_out_width_f  <- .bcw(4)
fig_out_width_g  <- .bcw(5)
fig_out_width_s  <- .bcw(6)
fig_out_width_st <- .bcw(7)
```

```{r conditional-annotation_taxa_barchart, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
}
```

```{r conditional-annotation_heatmap, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
  cat("The heatmap provides a visual representation of the bacterial composition in different samples, highlighting differences in the microbiome between groups. Each row represents a bacterial species, and each column represents a sample. The colors in the cells show how abundant each bacterial species is in each sample.", "\n", sep="")
}
```



```{r Go_barchart, include=FALSE}
convert_and_include_pdf <- function(tool, index, subgroup = NULL, wd, barchart) {
  pattern <- sprintf("%s.*\\(%s\\)%s.*\\.pdf$",tool,  barchart[index], ifelse(is.null(subgroup), "", paste0(".*", subgroup)))
  input_pdf <- list.files(path = wd, pattern = pattern, full.names = TRUE)
  
  if(length(input_pdf) == 0) {
    cat("No PDF files found for pattern:", pattern, "\n")
    return()
  }
  
  base_name <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(input_pdf[1]))
  output_png <- file.path(dirname(input_pdf[1]), paste0(base_name, ".png"))
  
  image_read_pdf(input_pdf[1], pages = 1) %>%
    image_convert(format = "png") %>%
    image_write(output_png)
  
  include_graphics(output_png)
}
```

```{r barplot-BC8, echo=FALSE, fig.align='center', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, out.width=fig_out_width_p, fig.height=15, fig.width=10, eval=!is.na(imgInfo$barchart[8])}
convert_and_include_pdf("barchart", 8, subgroup = NULL, dirInfo$image.wd, imgInfo$barchart)

```
